title: Script Background Worker Descriptor
description: Defines a scheduled JavaScript background worker.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use background workers for recurring scheduled work. Provide either `period` in milliseconds or `cronExpression`; do not provide both unless the host explicitly chooses one. Keep scripts idempotent and short. Use workers for polling, cleanup, synchronization, or recurring summary generation.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference used when this descriptor is stored as a model descriptor file.

name.description: Unique identifier for the background worker.

period.description: Execution period in milliseconds. Example: 300000 for every 5 minutes.

cronExpression.description: Cron expression for scheduler-backed providers. Omit it, set it to null, or leave it empty when the worker uses period-based scheduling.

javascript.description: JavaScript code to execute when the worker runs. Keep idempotent; workers may overlap or retry depending on scheduler configuration.

description.description: Optional description for designer documentation and model health context.
